description: HG003 ONT WGS variant-calling runtime, memory and I/O, Clair3 versus DeepVariant in GPU mode (Zheng et al. 2026 Supplementary Table 2)

attributes.protocol: Variant calling from aligned HG003 BAM to VCF at five coverages per platform; runtime, peak and average memory and total data movement per run.
limitations: One value per configuration and coverage is printed; the number of runs behind it is not stated and no spread is printed.
Author-reported: the authors develop Clair3; DeepVariant was run by them.

Hardware is not stated in Supplementary Table 2; the Methods give an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 with two 12-core Intel Xeon Silver 4116 processors for the GPU benchmarks, and Results 3.1 describe the Figure 2a runs on one RTX 4090 with 32 CPU threads.

Results 3.1.1 give different runtimes for what appear to be the same comparisons (Clair3 GPU 16 minutes at 30x and 15 at 50x; DeepVariant GPU 106 to 128 minutes) and name DeepVariant v1.8, while Supplementary Table 2 prints 17 and 20 minutes for Clair3 and 48 and 82 minutes for DeepVariant v1.10-beta.
The Methods say runtime and memory were measured with the GNU time command, which reports host process memory, not GPU memory; how data movement was measured is not stated.
Accuracy is printed in a separate table (Supplementary Table 3); the tables do not say they come from the same runs.
The source has an unresolved evidence concern (Supplementary Tables 2 and 3 conflict with the Results text); see the source record.

evidence_concerns.message: Supplementary Table 2 runtimes differ from the article's Results for what appear to be the same HG003 comparisons. ONT at 30x and 50x: Clair3 GPU 17 and 20 minutes in the table, 16 and 15 in Results 3.1.1; DeepVariant GPU 48 and 82 in the table, 106 to 128 in the text. PacBio Revio at 30x and 50x: Clair3 GPU 12 and 12 in the table, 23 and 21 in Results 3.1.2; DeepVariant GPU 40 and 53 in the table, 93 and 118 in the text. The table's Clair3 PacBio runtimes equal the macOS M3 Ultra runtime in Results 3.1.3, not the Linux RTX 4090 runtimes. The table and the Supplementary Notes commands give DeepVariant v1.10-beta; Results 3.1 say v1.8. Supplementary Table 3 DeepVariant ONT SNP precision, recall and F1 at 10x and 20x (97.58%, 92.35%, 94.89% and 99.32%, 99.02%, 99.17%) differ from Results 3.2 (97.34%, 92.17%, 94.68% and 98.75%, 98.79%, 98.79%), while the Clair3 values agree. Results 3.2 cite Supplementary Table 2 for the HG001 to HG007 comparison, which is Supplementary Table 4. The hardware, DeepVariant version and runs behind Supplementary Tables 2 and 3 are therefore uncertain. Supplementary Table 1 agrees with Results 3.1.4 except WhatsHap ONT 30x (723 seconds in the table, 724 in the text). Table values are recorded; text values are not.
